neper.notes: The baseline: the existing v2 pill button, all states. Unchanged by looks-polish; button_kinds.png adds the picture, split, toggle and busy buttons.

windows.notes: Matches the Options dialog and Format Report captures at 150 %: face #FDFDFD, border, accent default/focus border, visible box 73.3 x 21.3 (DFM 75 x 23 less the 1.67 the theme draws inside), label ink 47 px, disabled face #F9F9F9 / border #EAEAEA / label #878787 (measured on Apply). Added: dotted focus rectangle, picture + caption (centred group, 16 px picture), picture alone (29.3 wide), split button, toggle, busy ring, all in windows/button_kinds.png. DFM census: 102 TcxButton, 84 are 75 x 23, lfFlat/lfOffice11 with NativeStyle all draw the same native look. Dark palette: windows-dark/button.png and button_kinds.png; high-contrast palettes verified in renders, not committed as sheets. Evidence table: docs/ui/looks/windows-measurements.md.
gaps: Hover and pressed faces (#F6F6F6, #F0F0F0) are guesses: no v3 capture shows a hovered or pressed button
Toggled-on, split arrow part, busy ring size and the dotted rectangle's inset are guesses (no v3 capture of them)
The native border is darker at the bottom than the top (#C3C3C3 vs #D8D8D8) and the default button has a lighter inner ring: one flat border colour is drawn
The accelerator underline (&Apply) is not drawn
Segoe UI is used for every button; v3 dialogs that set Tahoma 8 pt (dxPrinting forms, 12 buttons) are not switched
Windows Dark and high-contrast colours are unmeasured (no v3 capture in those palettes)
The 1.67 px inset is measured at 150 % only; at 100 % the theme may inset by 1 px
